source.upstream: Maton Lemlist Cold Email Outreach skill

description: A real Lemlist Cold Email Outreach & Sales Engagement API skill for managed-OAuth access to campaigns, leads, sequences, A/B testing, email accounts, activities, and multi-channel outreach (email + LinkedIn).
authorization_notes: Campaign start triggers sends to all active leads in the campaign; confirm campaign name, lead count, and sequence content with the user before starting.
Bulk lead creation adds contacts to active sequences; confirm the campaign target and lead source before executing.
Sequence step modifications change the email content sent to all future leads; verify content for accuracy and authorization.
A/B testing variants send different email versions; confirm all variant contents before enabling.
Multi-channel sequences (LinkedIn) may perform actions beyond email; confirm cross-channel outreach plans with the user.
